test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The side of an equilateral triangular board is 12 m. Find the cost (in ₹) of fencing the board at ₹4.50 per meter.
solution:
**Given:**

Equilateral Triangle side (a) = 12m

**Concept used:**

Perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3a

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc057c93a56d397079e5965a8525d3d8c772653d60a64d11e59f6ea68ef99ae4.png] 

According to the questions,

Perimeter = 3 × 12 = 36

Total Fencing cost = 36 × 4.50 = 162

**∴ The total fencing cost is Rs 162.**
